transcript.text: Last spring I was in Beijing for a couple days, and I remember we kept talking about how parking there is its own little adventure.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Around that same time, my coworker was commuting between Beijing and Shanghai a lot, so those two cities were basically the whole travel storyline.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Then later in the year when I visited friends in Shenzhen, we ended up checking what movies were on in the city just to kill time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and in Beijing we also did the super touristy thing—people kept swapping notes on attractions like it was a checklist.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: One evening we actually parked at Sanlitun SOHO Parking, and I still remember the start time was 2025-03-25 17:00 because we were rushing from work.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: We left the car there for 6 hours, and the license plate on the receipt was 苏F89012, which I joked looked like a random password.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The funny part is the driver contact they wrote down was 13833445566, and we double-checked it like three times just in case.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For that Beijing-to-Shanghai hop, my friend had already gotten flight MU5678 on 2025-04-18, under Aiden Miller, and it was with China Eastern.
